leads.Verified Book Descriptions or Synopses: Christmas in His Arms: fleeing an abusive marriage, Sarah Walsh is sheltered for the night by billionaire Alec Harrow. Switched at Marriage: after his bride runs away days before the royal wedding, Prince Amadio asks look-alike American jewelry designer Genna Hamilton to stand in.
leads.Personalized Subject Line: Christmas with Alec and a royal switch
leads.Personalized Email Body:
Hi Avery,

My name is Roland Jacobs. I'm a designer and book services specialist, helping authors professionally present, publish, and promote their books.

I came across Christmas in His Arms and Switched at Marriage while researching your work. I was particularly interested in Sarah finding shelter with Alec Harrow and Genna's resemblance to the runaway princess.

Those details gave me an idea for how a holiday campaign could help present your books to more of the readers who may enjoy them. Christmas in His Arms is a natural lead for a holiday campaign that also introduces readers to Switched at Marriage.

I'd be happy to put together a complimentary concept sample so you can see the direction I have in mind.

Would you be open to taking a look?

Warm regards,
Roland Jacobs

leads.Personalized Email Body:
Hi Saharra,

My name is Roland Jacobs. I'm a designer and book services specialist, helping authors professionally present, publish, and promote their books.

I came across Spice Island and Queisha's Cove while researching your work. I was particularly interested in Angela being ransomed by a Sultan in Tanzania and the spy network hidden inside Mama's Travel Agency.

I'd be happy to put together a complimentary concept sample so you can see the direction I have in mind.

Would you be open to taking a look?

Warm regards,
Roland Jacobs
